title: Scenario
description: The frontmatter of scenarios/<context-slug>/<scenario-slug>.md. No subtypes: «the subject's class already distinguishes an invariant example from an end-to-end acceptance case, so a subtype would be a tag» (SPEC-003 §Scenario). Exactly one subject. The body carries `## Description`.

case.description: One sentence naming what this node does not decide, naming no node.

node.description: The node that decides the case, as a reference: a bare slug inside this node's directory, the full identity everywhere else.

excludes.description: The boundaries another node decides — «Any node may declare `excludes`: a list of entries, each a `case` — one sentence naming what this node does not decide — and the `node` that decides it, written as a reference (R2)» (SPEC-003 §The five classes). «It adds no obligation» (SPEC-003 §The five classes): a boundary declared here is one the validator resolves, and is not written into the prose a second time.

subject.description: The one anchor: a Domain Model element, a Rule, or a Contract, by full identity.

involves.description: The identities this scenario touches beyond its subject — «the references the capability map derives from» (SPEC-003 §Scenario).

examples.subject: rules/troubleshooting/hypothesis-requires-evidence
given: a case under investigation holds one hypothesis with no evidence
